title: Add reporter-reputation weighting (T3 mitigation)
description:
Threat-model T3 mitigation surface (design.md §9). The threat-model test suite (#39) ships an #[ignore]'d T3 weighting assertion because no reporter-reputation surface exists yet.

**Scope.** Add reporter-reputation scoring keyed on reporter DID: track historical false-report rate, then weight ObservationKind::ReportVolumeAnomaly by (1 - false_report_rate). Low-reputation reporters must not be able to trigger a high-confidence anomaly against an innocent subject.

**Tests.** The corresponding #[ignore] in tests/threat_t3_weaponized_reports.rs is un-ignored once this lands.
